BiblicalUsage: Pekah son of Remaliah was a captain who conspired against King Pekahiah, killed him in Samaria, and reigned in his place. He reigned twenty years over Israel, and in the days of Ahaz he went up with Rezin of Syria against Jerusalem, but could not prevail.
TheologicalSignificance: What I hold is that a throne taken by conspiracy is a throne God will not keep: Pekah reigned twenty years and ended in judgment, and Jerusalem stood.
RelatedPeople: Pekah, Son of Remaliah; Remaliah, Father of Pekah
